scope: DEVICE_MEASURED, situational session-LLM controller, Pokemon Gold / My OldBoy 2.0.3 / Moto g56
objective: Prepare Slowqueen for Whitney, preserve Curse, retain long-term team; acquire Headbutt and Confusion, train Flaaffy toward Thunder Wave when feasible
authorization: Pedro requests full preparation and LLM visual verification instead of bespoke detectors (2026-10-05); Pedro permits grouping predictable actions and inference rather than reading every frame
productAndroidBackends: remain read-only; closed research runner uses independently packaged original FNaF transport and lease algorithms

sameTransportRepeatedBlock.everyContact: Inferred continuation, fresh foreground guard, common executor and release after every contact; sensor capture at declared boundary (end by default, each optional).
sameTransportRepeatedBlock.purpose: avoid reopening HID between predictable dialog/Headbutt actions; no autonomous semantic stop

sameTransportMixedBlock.durations: Each contact uses a preregistered bounded duration; long holds only for navigation.
sameTransportMixedBlock.everyContact: Shared executor, foreground guard and release; later decisions marked inferred. Capture at the declared block boundary, not an asserted fresh view between inferred steps.
sameTransportMixedBlock.criticalChoices: Do not batch successive A confirmations across uncertain replacement/learning dialogs; verify the party or learning menu before confirming.

method: Session LLM reviews the selected sensor image and binds its hash. Each common-executor iteration dispatches one bounded contact. A declared block reuses HID for up to eight explicit actions. Capture defaults to block end; optional each-contact capture. Deferred observations retain the old image and timestamp and explicitly record captureDeferred; they do not assert a new scene or result. Outcomes remain UNKNOWN until LLM review.
calibration: Menu directions exercised in prior experiments. Left/Right must be visually qualified on first use. Nominal 150ms is not measured app landing duration. Longer navigation-only holds are bounded experiments; visually verify first effect. No fixed tile count inferred.
guards: One original lease per complete action/capture
Fresh reviewed image, bound hash, one-use
Input release and process close in finally
Pause and reacquire on unknown scene or external interruption
gameConstraints: Do not withdraw from Day Care at level 20 or above without move-queue analysis
No inventory item consumption by automation; use free Pokemon Center healing and healthy long-term party members (Pedro, 2026-10-05)
No save edits, ROM edits, cheats, reset or state restore
measurementLimits: LLM judgments are nonblinded and fallible
Foreground and pixels are sequential witnesses
No deterministic unattended farming or generic vision claim
rawEvidence: ignored .operator only; sanitized manifests and narrative may be committed
inference: A bounded LLM-authored sequence may use inferred scene decisions. Contacts stay serialized and recorded; capture can be deferred to a declared review boundary. Unreviewed outcomes remain UNKNOWN. Stop at learning, battle choice, low HP or unexpected scene. Controller identifies visual versus inferred decisions.
speedTrial: Historical 2x trial completed; Fast forward is now OFF by user preference. Faster factors unqualified.
